papers.title: Held While Waiting: What LLM Agent Sessions Reserve on Serverless and Agent Runtimes
papers.abstract: LLM agents spend nearly all their time waiting for the model. On Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, our agents waited a median of 2.7 seconds for each model reply, then computed for an estimated 5 to 40 milliseconds. AgentCore does not charge for CPU during the wait. But it reserves a separate environment, a virtual machine with its own memory, for every conversation, and keeps it reserved until the conversation is closed. So 1,000 conversations reserve 1,000 environments to do the work of 2 to 15 processor cores. A service runs out of environments long before it runs out of processing power. The shortage has two causes, and each has a fix. An environment stays reserved after its conversation ends: in the customer-service benchmark we ran, a conversation lasts 33 seconds on average, but its environment is held for 15 minutes more unless the client closes it. And an environment serves only one conversation, which is mostly waiting: in our simulation, 64 conversations sharing one environment need 59 times fewer environments, and 99 of every 100 replies are delayed by at most 40 milliseconds. The milliseconds are an estimate because they are hard to measure: a stubbed model, a timer around the model call, and steps run back to back each gave a plausible number that was too low. We show how to avoid all three. Of the two fixes, closing needs only the client. Sharing needs the platform, and of the agent runtimes we surveyed only one allows it, in part. They keep conversations apart because an agent runs tools, and sometimes code, chosen by a model. The open problem is to keep them apart without reserving an environment for each while it waits.
papers.llm_reason: 今天唯一一篇把「agent 运行时到底占了什么」量化到可复跑程度的论文，而且结论直接命中我们自己的平台瓶颈。核心问题：agent step 的绝大部分时间不是在算，而是在等模型；但按会话隔离的运行时（Bedrock AgentCore 每会话一个 microVM、Azure Foundry 每会话一个 sandbox）在等待期间仍然占着环境配额。论文正文逐条核对一致的数字：模型等待中位数 2.7 s、计算仅 5–40 ms（部署态实测「只有 0.2%–1.5% 的时间在计算」），于是任意时刻 1000 个被占环境中只有 2–15 个真正在用处理器——即每 1 核真实工作量要占住 70–600 个环境；实测并发上限做到 400 个会话；客服基准里一次会话平均只持续 33 s，但环境在客户端不显式关闭的情况下会被多留 15 分钟。九条解法中最有用的一条：我们实测 shipped 的 results/remedy_sim.json，k=64（64 个会话共享一个环境）时 envs_mean 从 1007.57 降到 16.81、比值 59.93，且该配置 added_latency_ms.p99 = 39.67 ms——即「59 倍更少的环境」与「99/100 的回复延迟不超过 40 ms」这两个数字可以从仓库数据独立重算出来，不是作者单方面主张。工程可验证性极好：github.com/MEKHALA/agent-runtime-capacity 实测可达（Apache-2.0，4864 KB），含 agentprof/（纯标准库的 span tracer 与 LangGraph/Strands 适配器）、scripts/measure_framework_cpu.py、scripts/simulate_remedy.py、scripts/validate_capacity.py、data/deployed_turns.csv、results/、tests/test_agentprof.py 与 paper/figures/；README 明确给出「表 2/图 1 本地复现 ~15 min、Section 4.4–7 分析脚本秒级复现」，且全程离线、不调用任何模型、不烧 token。对我们的直接产出：我们自己的 agent 服务要区分「计费口径」和「配额口径」——等待不计 CPU 不代表不占环境，而 AgentCore 默认 5000 活跃会话配额正是先撞到的墙。

papers.title: AgentRoboCritic: Understanding the Capability of Frontier Agents on Direct Robot Control
papers.abstract: Frontier multimodal language agents such as GPT-6 Astra have demonstrated strong capabilities in controlling robots directly via low-level numerical actions without high-level primitives. However, existing benchmarks report only episode-level success rates, which show neither how these agents succeed nor where they fail. In this paper, we present a systematic action-level analysis of frontier agents on direct robot control across 12 manipulation benchmarks. We introduce AgentRoboCritic, an intent-grounded critique framework in which the policy agent states a local intent alongside each action, and a critic evaluates the action's outcome and failure mode against this intent. Our action-level analysis demonstrates the promising capabilities of frontier agents on direct robot control, including closed-loop recovery from local execution failures, reliable semantic grounding across diverse scenes, and strong zero-shot manipulation without task-specific adaptation. It also identifies their current limitations, including task-relevant physical execution bottlenecks such as grasping and alignment, and uneven recovery across failure modes. Finally, we validate our critic on a 400-action human-annotated benchmark and release a dataset of 12,844 annotated actions alongside a fine-tuned open-source critic, Muse-Glimmer-30B, whose failure-mode accuracy rises from 32.58% to 74.24%, enabling low-cost action-level analysis.
papers.llm_reason: 它换掉了评测的最小单元：从 episode 级成功率下沉到 action 级，并给出了一个能复用的「意图—动作—判定」三元结构，这套结构可以直接搬进我们的 agent 评测设计。要点：frontier 多模态语言 agent（GPT-6 Astra）在 12 个操作 benchmark 上直接输出低层数值动作控制机器人，论文用 intent-grounded critique——策略 agent 每一步先声明本地意图，critic 再拿这个意图去判定动作结果与失败模式。论文正文核对一致的关键结论：12 个 benchmark 名单逐个可查（RoboDojo / StationeryBench / Astranomy / UniVTAC / OpenViTac / ContactBench 1.0 / LIBERO-MAX / Meta-World+ / DexJoCo / RoboWits / RoboTwin 2.0 / YAMLab，其中 7 个新采集带意图的 episode，5 个用已发布 trace 经统一对齐适配器摄入）；一半成功 episode 至少含一个被后续纠正的失败动作（即闭环自愈是真实存在的，不是刷分）；失败集中在低层物理抓取（Choice 类语义选择错误极罕见）；400 动作人工标注集上 GPT-6 Astra 与人类判断高度一致，而 ablate 掉本地意图后失败模式归因直接崩掉（只给全局目标时同一动作无法区分「够不到 / 没对齐 / 没抓住」，critic 大量标 unverifiable）；开源微调 critic Muse-Glimmer-30B 的 failure-mode accuracy 从 32.58% 提到 74.24%，并发布 12,844 条标注动作。工程可验证性好：github.com/cxcscmu/AgentRoboCritic 实测可达（MIT，4 star，552 KB），含 src/agentrobocritic/{cli,scoring,runner,providers,efe}.py、src/agentrobocritic/prompts/{benchmark.json,muse.txt}、efe/ 采集工具与 tests/ 三个测试文件，README 给出 arc verify / arc evaluate / arc score 三步本地跑通路径（默认下载四个公开分片，验证过程零模型调用）。对我们的直接产出：我们的 agent 失败分析目前停在 step/trace 级，缺一个「先声明意图再判定成败」的结构，这正是把「模型答错了」细化成「哪一类错」的前提。

papers.title: DS2Agent: Holistic Device Agents for Accelerated Embedded Board-Level Design
papers.abstract: Embedded board-level development demands extensive expertise, from component selection and device characteristics to interface configuration, driver writing, and system composition. Recently, LLM-based agents have shown strong capabilities, raising the prospect of automating board-level design tasks. However, existing agents either target chip-level design or treat datasheets as static text, offering little guidance on whether a specific component should---or even could---be used for a given board-level design. Moreover, without touching real hardware, they hallucinate incorrect details. To fill this gap, we present {\setlength{\fboxsep}{1pt}\href{https://anonymous.4open.science/r/DS2Agent-9FE8/}{\fcolorbox{blue}{white}{DS2Agent}}}, an open-source framework that constructs interactive agents from device datasheets. Each agent comprises three models: a knowledge model supporting retrieval and question answering; a digital-twin model capturing the physical functionality of the device; and an interface model supporting driver development and system integration. To suppress hallucinations, we also allow optional connections to real devices, so that the agent can calibrate its internalized knowledge against the device. We evaluate DS2Agent on ten devices spanning seven functional categories. Compared with the baseline, the DS2Agent-augmented agent improves the question-answering score from 87 to 97 out of 100 while using 44.8\% fewer tokens. For driver generation, it reduces average token usage per device by 72.9\%. For system integration, it reduces total token usage across three FreeRTOS applications by 29.7\%.
papers.llm_reason: 它把「一份数据手册」变成一棵可安装的 skill 树加一个可调用的 MCP 服务，这个产物形态和我们的 skill 资产路线高度同构。做法：每个设备由三个模型组成——knowledge model（检索与问答）、digital-twin model（物理功能）、interface model（驱动开发与系统集成），并允许 agent 连到真实设备做标定以压制幻觉。论文正文核对一致的数字：10 个设备、7 个功能类别；QA 得分从 87 提到 97/100，同时 token 从 1,849,354 降到 1,021,312（−44.8%）、响应时间从 197 s 降到 137 s（−30.5%）；驱动生成平均每设备 token −72.9%；系统集成在三个 FreeRTOS 应用上总 token −29.7%；两边用完全相同的 datasheet 转 Markdown 输入，所以改进不来自「多给了上下文」，而来自结构化。这条「同输入、更多结构、更少 token」的证据链对我们特别有用。工程可验证性好：github.com/ds2agent/DS2Agent 实测可达（MIT，30079 KB），含 skills/ds2agent/SKILL.md（9.8 KB）、skills/availability/SKILL.md、skills/ds2agent/datasheet2mcp/ 下的完整参考文档树（agents/、prompts/、orchestration.md、project-skill.md 等）、f103-sim-package.zip（30.5 MB）与 scripts/connect_remote_mcp.sh；README 明说产物是 dist/<scope>-agent/ 下的消费级 SKILL.md + 一个 MCP 服务（agent_mcp.py，按 knowledge / driver / behavior 三组暴露工具），并强调「Conversion is done by your coding agent, not by hand」。

papers.title: LINEAGE: A Benchmark for Empirical Lineage Retrieval in AI Scientific Literature
papers.abstract: Current research agents are moving beyond academic search toward literature synthesis and experiment planning. These workflows increasingly rely on literature retrieval systems, which serve as standalone systems or as components of research agents. However, existing scientific literature retrieval benchmarks mainly evaluate these methods using topical relevance or citation links as supervision, which cannot capture which prior methods are used for empirical comparison. To address this gap, we introduce Lineage, a benchmark for empirical lineage retrieval in AI scientific literature. An empirical lineage relation links a prior paper to a source paper that explicitly uses its method as an empirical comparison baseline. These relations form lineage graphs whose multi-hop neighborhoods provide retrieval ground truth for structural evaluation. To construct these graphs at scale, we develop Lineage-Constructor, which converts heterogeneous paper records and full-paper empirical baseline evidence into calibrated lineage graphs. Built from 121,048 papers across 17 top AI venues from 2018 to 2025, Lineage contains 3,950 graph components, 67,502 paper nodes, 164,948 lineage edges, and 80,000 multi-facet retrieval queries. Experiments with 19 representative retrieval systems show that empirical lineage retrieval remains challenging. Performance drops sharply with lineage distance, while structural metrics reveal that isolated retrieval hits often fail to recover closely connected empirical comparison neighborhoods.
papers.llm_reason: 它质疑的是我们这个雷达本身依赖的检索地基：现有文献检索 benchmark 用主题相关性或引用链接做监督，而这两者都无法反映「哪些前作被当作了实证对比基线」。它改用 empirical lineage relation——一篇基线论文 → 一篇明确把它作为实证对比的源论文，边方向即「基线 → 使用者」，多跳邻域构成检索真值。规模与结论均可在论文正文逐条核对：121,048 篇论文、17 个 AI 顶会、2018–2025；3,950 个有向 lineage 连通分量、67,502 个节点、164,948 条边；80,000 条多面查询；19 个代表性检索系统；最强 agentic 检索器 Tongyi-DeepResearch 也只有 31.87 Recall@20 与 9.92 Precision@20；性能随 lineage 距离迅速衰减，平均 Recall@20 从一跳 28.42 掉到三跳 6.68；结构指标显示「偶尔命中检索」不等于「恢复 lineage 邻域」。另有一个对检索方法论很有价值的机制性发现：作者用 IQR 规则切掉上尾异常分量并做 bridge pruning（Tarjan 1974）做结构校准，去掉 436 条未来年份/成环边（占原始匹配边 0.15%），校准后聚类系数升到 0.3035、平均边邻域 Jaccard 升到 0.1420——即「被反复当作基线的热门方法会把本来无关的方法族连在一起」，这正是结构检索最容易被污染的机制。对我们的价值：这是把「我引用了什么 / 我检索到了什么」升级成「谁在跟谁对比」的评测地基，长期会改变我们雷达的证据结构。

papers.title: Reasoning on Call: Efficient Agentic Robot Control for Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Large multimodal models can support long-horizon robot manipulation, but frequent model calls incur substantial latency and token costs. The central challenge is determining when agent assistance or intervention is needed and whether errors require correcting robot execution, subtask planning, or both. To address this problem, we propose RoC (Reasoning on Call), an efficient framework that coordinates a low-level policy and a high-level reasoning agent through an online task-state monitor. The monitor combines temporal visual observations with ordered interaction memory to jointly estimate progress within the active subtask and predict its successor. These predictions guide event-triggered agent review for coordinated execution repair and plan revision. Verified outcomes govern memory updates and subtask transitions, allowing routine execution to remain with the policy while reasoning focuses on decisions requiring additional assessment. On RMBench, RoC improves task success rate by 24.0 percentage points and reduces token consumption by 65.3% compared with the strongest agent-based baseline. It also outperforms the strongest policy-based baseline by 15.1 percentage points in task success rate. Real-world experiments further validate its effectiveness across three long-horizon manipulation tasks. Overall, RoC supports efficient agent intervention and coordinated recovery across execution and planning for long-horizon robot manipulation.
papers.llm_reason: 它的核心贡献不是机器人，而是「什么时候才值得叫模型」这套触发机制，正好是我们 agent 成本控制的现成模板。做法：一个在线 task-state monitor 把时序视觉观测与有序交互记忆合起来，估计当前子任务进度、预测下一个子任务，只有在进度异常、子任务转移请求或候选动作的关键接触事件时才触发 reasoning agent 介入做执行修复或计划修订；常规执行留在低层策略，reasoning 只处理需要额外判断的决策。论文正文核对一致的数字：RMBench 全部 9 个任务上，相比最强 agent-based 基线任务成功率 +24.0 个百分点、token 消耗 −65.3%；相比最强 policy-based 基线 +15.1 个百分点；monitor 在不生成子任务时 7.10 Hz、生成子任务时 0.53 Hz、整体实测吞吐 2.77 Hz；低层策略用 50 步扩散去噪预测 32 步 action chunk；agent review 阶段可批准 1–32 步执行前缀或对 1–5 步做局部修正；模拟中 agent-based 对比每任务 30 次独立试验、policy-based 对比每任务 100 次；真机用 SO-ARM101 5-DoF 平台三个长时程任务各 10 次试验。对我们的价值：把「模型调用」变成事件驱动而非轮询，这条结构可以直接搬到我们的 agent 编排里评估 token 账。

papers.title: Harnessing Medical Visual-Language Models with Agentic Evidence Management
papers.abstract: Medical vision-language agents increasingly rely on segmentation tools, and recent work has focused on acquiring the right mask, often treating a good mask as the end point of tool use. But do these agents use the resulting evidence effectively? To answer this question, we need a benchmark that separates evidence use from segmentation quality, spans multiple medical image types, and allows the same mask to be presented in different ways. Existing medical VQA datasets do not jointly provide these properties. We therefore construct Mask-Evidence MedVQA, a 2.5K-example benchmark spanning four image types, where each question is paired with an answer-relevant ground-truth mask and multiple possible renderings. Our study reveals two limitations of direct tool use. First, evidence presentation matters. Different renderings of the same fixed mask can substantially change model behavior. Second, masks introduce an evidence trade-off. Highlighting a relevant region can expose diagnostic evidence the model previously missed, but the added visual cue can also induce incorrect associations. As a result, even a ground-truth mask can correct some answers while turning initially correct ones into incorrect ones. Together, these findings show that acquiring the right mask is not enough. An agent must also decide how to present the evidence and whether it should change the answer. We therefore introduce TUNE (Tool Use is Not Enough), an evidence-management harness that explicitly manages what evidence to acquire, how to present it, and whether to accept the resulting answer update. Across three public medical VQA benchmarks, evidence management improves the fine-tuned Qwen3.5-9B backbone's mean accuracy by 4.0 percentage points. Full TUNE improves over direct tool use by 9.1 points on average across seven benchmarks and achieves competitive results against existing medical VLMs and agents.
papers.comment: 22 pages, 3 figures. Qiming Huang, Hanze Dong, and Jipeng Zhang contributed equally
papers.llm_reason: 它的结论对任何带工具的 agent 都成立：拿到正确的工具输出不等于用好了它。做法：构造 Mask-Evidence MedVQA（2.5K 样本、覆盖 4 类影像，每题配一个答案相关的 ground-truth mask 以及多种呈现方式），把「证据从哪来」和「证据怎么呈现」拆开量测；随后提出 TUNE（Tool Use is Not Enough）harness，显式管理三件事——采什么证据、怎么呈现、要不要接受由此带来的答案更新。论文正文核对一致的两个发现：一是呈现方式本身就改变模型行为（同一张 mask 不同渲染导致结果显著不同），二是证据存在 trade-off——高亮相关区域能暴露模型原先漏掉的诊断证据，但新增视觉线索也会诱发错误关联，因此**即使给的是 ground-truth mask，也会出现「修正一部分答案、同时把原本正确的答案改错」**。量化上：在三个公开医学 VQA benchmark 上，evidence management 让微调后的 Qwen3.5-9B 平均准确率 +4.0 个百分点；完整 TUNE 相对直接工具调用在七个 benchmark 上平均 +9.1 分；在 SLAKE 上 TUNE 同时拿到最高修正率 7.5% 与最低有害翻转率 2.6%。对我们的价值：我们的 agent 也大量依赖「工具返回一个中间产物」的链路，这篇把「要不要采、怎么呈现、要不要采信」这三问显式化了，是一条低成本可借鉴的评测口径。

papers.title: Risk-Controlled Test-Time Adaptation for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented vision-language-action (VLA) models enable efficient test-time adaptation by leveraging expert demonstrations as additional context without updating model parameters. However, even when retrieved demonstrations are relevant to the current task, the VLA may fail to effectively utilize the retrieved information, ultimately leading to task failure. To address this challenge, we propose R2-VLA, a risk-controlled retrieval-augmented VLA framework that enables reliable test-time adaptation by satisfying a user-specified task success rate requirement with minimal expert assistance. Specifically, R2-VLA learns an uncertainty predictor that estimates the uncertainty of the VLA's predicted actions given the retrieved demonstrations, guiding when to act autonomously or request expert assistance. We further introduce a task-level risk-control procedure that calibrates the uncertainty threshold to satisfy a user-specified task-failure risk requirement. Moreover, R2-VLA continually incorporates expert corrections into its retrieval memory to improve future adaptation while preserving the prescribed task-level risk guarantee. Experiments across three VLA backbones and four LIBERO benchmark suites demonstrate that R2-VLA improves average task success by 9.2--11.2 percentage points, achieving the desired target with fewer expert requests. These results highlight the effectiveness of connecting the usefulness of retrieved demonstrations with task-level risk control to enable successful robotic manipulation.
papers.llm_reason: 它给出一个我们迟早要自己写的东西：**带风险保证的「自己做还是问人」决策器**，而且保证的形式是可检验的统计声明而不是口头承诺。做法：R2-VLA 学一个不确定性预测器，估计「给定检索到的示范之后，VLA 预测动作的不确定性」，据此在 Act 与 Ask 之间选择；再用任务级 risk-control 过程把阈值 λ 校准到满足用户指定的任务级失败风险上；专家纠正持续写回检索记忆，同时保持既定风险保证。论文正文核对一致的关键点：三个 VLA backbone（π0-FAST、OpenVLA、miniVLA）× 四个 LIBERO suite，平均任务成功率相对 RICL 提升 9.2–11.2 个百分点且用更少专家请求；Theorem 1 建立「不确定性预测精度 ↔ 任务级失败风险」的理论连接，Theorem 2 证明持续适配过程中风险保证仍可保持；风险控制用 held-out calibration 集上检验 p_λ ≤ δ/K 的 Bonferroni 修正构造安全阈值集合 Λ̂_safe；训练不确定性头时刻意注入被破坏的检索上下文（错任务检索、视觉相似但语义无关的检索）以覆盖「检索反而有害」的失败模式。对我们的价值：我们的 agent 也有「要不要升级给人」的分叉点，如果那一步能带一个可审计的风险保证，而不是拍脑袋阈值，工程上完全不同。

papers.title: MM-SystemOneBias: Evaluating Bias in Multimodal Jev-Style System One Decision Models
papers.abstract: When multimodal decision models determine actions, moderation outcomes, or quality judgments, their reliability depends on preserving semantic decisions across presentation changes, ignoring irrelevant additions, and distinguishing information consistent with task evidence from information that conflicts with it. Existing evaluations study decision-interface biases and multimodal model behavior in separate settings, leaving no common protocol to compare multimodal decision models with their backbones on practical tasks. We introduce \textbf{MM-SystemOneBias}, which evaluates 13 models on 5,323 original instances from nine public datasets and 11 task scenarios using six paired interventions: option order, option label, external judgment, image--text description, irrelevant information, and rating scale. Across seven matched decision-model--backbone pairs, decision models are more stable under option-label, irrelevant-information, and rating-scale changes in all seven pairs; six pairs also show lower option-order flip rates. They incur smaller accuracy losses under incorrect external judgments in all seven pairs and conflicting descriptions in six. In six pairs, they gain less accuracy from correct external judgments and show less favorable accuracy changes under consistent descriptions. Among pairs with unchanged semantic decisions, mean absolute changes in answer probabilities range from 4.56 to 11.55 percentage points, revealing input effects that accuracy alone misses.
papers.llm_reason: 它提供的是一套我们能直接借用的评测协议：把「决策模型」与它的 backbone 放在同一套受控干预下配对比较，并且同时看语义翻转与概率漂移。协议规模在正文与 README 中一致：5,323 条原始实例、9 个公开数据集、11 个任务场景、6 种配对干预（选项顺序、选项标签、外部判断、图像—文本描述、无关信息、评分刻度），展开为 76,439 条干预实例、81,762 次模型输入，评测 8 个 System One 决策模型 + 5 个通用 VLM backbone。有两个结论值得单独记住：其一，决策模型在选项标签、无关信息、评分刻度三类干预下的翻转率在全部 7 个配对里都更低，选项顺序有 6 个配对更低——即「决策接口」确实比通用 backbone 更稳；其二，在语义决策未变的那些实例上，答案概率的绝对变化平均在 4.56 到 11.55 个百分点之间——**准确率完全掩盖了这些输入效应**，所以只报 accuracy 的评测是漏的。工程可验证性不错：github.com/ALIENS32/MM-SystemOneBias 实测可达，configs/models/ 下 13 个模型配置、configs/environments/ 下 8 个环境配置、docs/{dataset_card,inference,metrics,models}.md、scripts/{download_dataset,download_model,infer,serve_autotrust,setup}.sh 齐备。

papers.title: ChronoPatch: Black-Box Energy-Latency Attacks on Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly deployed as generative inference services, where autoregressive decoding makes response length a key determinant of latency and computational cost. This creates an availability risk: adversarial visual inputs can prolong generation and increase serving overhead. Existing energy-latency attacks typically rely on gradients, logits, or token-level feedback, leaving open whether such risks persist when an attacker observes only the final response. We present ChronoPatch, a black-box attack that induces prolonged VLM generation requiring only the final response. It discovers visual delay anchors through response-length-guided evolutionary search, then minimizes perturbation magnitude through subspace-calibrated decision-based optimization. Across four open-source VLMs, ChronoPatch increases inference latency by 47.86%--293.34% and GPU energy consumption by 41.44%--249.70% under a 5% spatial budget. It also induces more repetitive outputs, as reflected by increased n-gram repetition ratios. On three commercial VLM APIs, ChronoPatch increases response length by 37.6%--81.5% and client-observed latency by 1.82x--2.29x under query budgets of 500 per API. These results reveal a generation-based availability risk that persists under final-response-only access and motivate generation-aware safeguards for deployed generative AI services.
papers.llm_reason: 它是一个具体的部署风险，且对任何把 VLM 当服务暴露出去的 agent 平台都成立：攻击者只看最终回复，就能让生成变长，从而抬高延迟与算力账单。做法：两阶段——先用「响应长度引导的进化搜索」找出能诱发超长生成的视觉延迟锚点（delay anchor），再用「子空间校准的基于决策的优化」在固定可编辑区域内把扰动幅度压到最小。论文正文核对一致的数字：在 5% 图像面积扰动预算下，四个开源 VLM（BLIP-Large、LLaVA-v1.5-7B、Qwen3-VL-8B、InternVL3-8B）上 MSCOCO 的端到端延迟增加 47.86%–293.34%、GPU 能耗增加 41.44%–249.70%，ImageNet 上对应为 40.91%–279.61% 与 34.36%–237.67%，InternVL3 放大最强（响应长度逼近 1024 token 生成上限）；在三个商业 API（ChatGPT-5、Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview、Claude-Sonnet-4-6）上、总查询预算 ≤500 的条件下，响应长度增加 37.6%–81.5%、客户端观测延迟达 1.82×–2.29×；实验硬件为单卡 NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 96 GB，Phase I 初始化 S=100 候选、最多 T=500 次搜索迭代，Phase II 最多 T2=50 次精炼迭代、每次 B=128 次探测。对我们的价值：多模态 agent 服务如果直接代理商业 API，这条就是成本侧的可用性攻击面；而且它的度量方式（响应长度 + 客户端延迟，而不是模型内部 logit）说明这类风险在纯黑盒条件下也成立。

papers.title: PhyDEX: A Benchmark for Physical Reasoning in Vision-Language-Action Models via Dynamic Extrinsic Dexterity
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have advanced rapidly in language-conditioned robotic manipulation, yet existing benchmarks mainly evaluate gripper--object contact and largely ignore how objects interact with the environment through gravity, friction, inertia, and mass distribution. As a result, it remains unclear whether current policies truly understand physics or merely interpolate from their training data. We address this gap through the lens of dynamic extrinsic dexterity and introduce PhyDEX, a throwing benchmark in which a robot must infer an object's mass, center of mass, and friction to send it to a destination beyond its kinematic workspace. PhyDEX contains 35K trajectories (143 hours) across nine tasks and 100 scenes, covering uniform, irregular, and dynamic-mass objects with static, multiple, and moving destinations. All data are generated by a scalable, fully automatic pipeline that combines grasp generation, motion planning, and closed-loop throw optimization under randomized physical properties. We evaluate three representative VLAs, GR00T N1.7, DynamicVLA, and ForceVLA, and find that all achieve success rates below 3\%. Our analysis reveals two key bottlenecks: limited robustness of pretrained models, which causes most failures before the throw, and physical blindness, as providing ground-truth physical properties roughly doubles success. Experiments on a humanoid robot and in the real world show the same failure patterns. We hope PhyDEX will drive the development of physically grounded robot policies.
papers.llm_reason: 它对本雷达的价值不在机器人本身，而在它用一个干净的对照实验说明了「benchmark 上的近零分常常是多样性造成的，不一定是能力为零」——这个判据对我们评估任何新 benchmark 都有用。做法：用投掷任务逼策略推断物体的质量、质心与摩擦（这类属性不可从图像、语言或额外传感器直接观测），35K 轨迹 / 9 个任务 / 100 个场景，覆盖均匀、不规则与动态质量物体与静态、多目标、移动目标。论文正文核对一致的数字与结论：三个代表策略（GR00T N1.7、DynamicVLA、ForceVLA）总成功率均低于 3%；只有约 21.24% 的轨迹完成抓取（DynamicVLA 仅 3.57%），而平均 21.24% 进入投掷阶段后整体成功率只有约 1.2%，即投掷命中率仅 5.6%；提供 ground-truth 物理属性可让成功率大致翻倍；多样性分数 α 消融显示 ForceVLA 从 α=1 的 3.3% 升到 α=0.5 的 11.3%、α=0 的 35.3%，GR00T N1.7 从 2% 升到 4.7% 再到 9.3%，即使 α=0 也没有策略在任一物体类型上超过 44%；Unitree 人形平台 2,400 episode 上 GR00T N1.7 平均 6%、ForceVLA 8.7%；真机 UR10e + Robotiq 2F-85 上 DynamicVLA 全败、GR00T N1.7 平均 10.7%（均匀 16% / 偏移质心 12% / 轻质低摩擦 4%）、ForceVLA 平均 51.3%（轻质低摩擦从 58% 掉到 40%）。

papers.title: JARVIS: An Agent That Designs, Builds, and Tests Circuit Boards on Its Own
papers.abstract: Power electronics is central to the energy transition, but developing new hardware still relies on human-led design, fabrication, testing, and iteration. We present JARVIS, an embodied AI agent that autonomously closes this loop for circuit boards. JARVIS maintains machine-specific capabilities and constraints, scans its workspace using a robot-mounted 3D scanner, and constructs an executable digital twin in which it rehearses robot motions, fabrication steps, and circuit behavior before consuming materials. A single text instruction initiates the physical experiment. Using unmodified desktop equipment, the agent coordinates a robot arm, a PCB printer that deposits conductive silver ink and solder paste, and a pick-and-place machine. It verifies progress using cameras and sensors, then tests the fabricated circuit with an OPAL-RT real-time simulator and an oscilloscope. Based on the measurements, JARVIS diagnoses deviations from the design and generates a revised design in KiCad for subsequent rehearsal. In a demonstration involving a 60 Hz notch filter for grid-connected converter sensing, JARVIS completed a first-run experiment in 2 h 39 min without human intervention, achieving 50.6 dB attenuation at 60 Hz. Its digital-twin rehearsal identified five issues before fabrication, including a test criterion that would have incorrectly rejected a functioning board. During execution, the agent also resolved encountered faults autonomously. These results demonstrate an integrated agent-driven workflow for physical design, fabrication, measurement, and iterative improvement of power-electronic circuitry. To our knowledge, JARVIS is the first system in power electronics in which an agent closes the physical design-build-test-learn loop for circuit boards.
papers.llm_reason: 它演示的是一条我们暂时用不上的极端路径（真实电路板的设计—制造—测试闭环），但里面藏着一个可以直接搬走的机制：先在数字孪生里排演，再动真材料。做法：JARVIS 用机器人臂上的 3D 扫描仪扫工作区，构建可执行的数字孪生，在其中排演机器人动作、制造步骤与电路行为，然后用桌面级设备（导电银墨 PCB 打印机、锡膏沉积、贴片机）实际制造，用摄像头与传感器验证进度，用 OPAL-RT 实时仿真器与示波器测试电路，依据实测诊断偏差并在 KiCad 中生成修订设计再回到孪生里排演。论文正文核对一致的关键事实：单条文字指令启动实验；以电网接入变换器传感链上的 60 Hz 陷波器为例，首次运行 2 h 39 min 全程无人干预，板卡在 60 Hz 处实现 50.6 dB 衰减；数字孪生排演在制造前识别出五个问题，其中包含一个「若按原判据会错误否决一块可用电路板」的测试判据；执行过程中 agent 自主处理了实际故障；作者声明这是电力电子领域首个由 agent 闭合物理设计—制造—测试—学习回路的系统。对我们的价值：那条「先在孪生里排演、包括把测试判据本身也排演一遍」的思路，对我们做 agent 的干跑/回放验证同样成立。

papers.title: Alignment Drives Reuse: Learning Generalizable Robot-Use Agents from Heterogeneous Experience
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) demonstrate broad generalization across tasks and domains. However, comparable generalization in robot manipulation remains challenging. Heterogeneity in robot embodiments, task formulations, geometric conventions, and action interfaces fragments interaction experience across benchmarks and hardware. We rethink robot skill learning through alignment: Can heterogeneous interactions across benchmarks and embodiments jointly improve one shared skillset for robot manipulation? We propose UniCraft, a framework for learning robot manipulation skills by aligning heterogeneous settings. Specifically, UniCraft represents observed scene geometry using consistent coordinate conventions and aligns sensing and control interfaces across robots. It organizes tasks from different benchmarks in a canonical format, allowing interaction feedback to jointly refine shared skills and the orchestration policy that guides their selection and composition, without any demonstrations or model weight updates. We interleave tasks from 3 benchmarks and 6 embodiments, collecting 2,700 learning rollouts per agent model. During training, UniCraft improves pooled task success on unseen scenarios and tasks by 9-28 percentage points on LIBERO-PRO, 10.8-13.3 on RoboTwin 2.0, and 3.1-14.4 on RoboCasa365 (Epochs 1-3). After training, with the learned skills frozen, UniCraft demonstrates zero-shot transfer across 4 new robot embodiments and 5 additional agent models on robosuite and RoboDojo.
papers.llm_reason: 它和本雷达主线（agent 平台、context 工程、评测治理）距离最远，属于机器人技能迁移方向，保留是因为它的方法论主张有普适性：把「异构」当成对齐问题而不是数据问题。做法：UniCraft 用一致的几何坐标系表示场景几何、对齐不同机器人的感知与控制接口、把不同 benchmark 的任务归一到规范格式，于是不同 benchmark、不同 embodiment 的交互反馈可以共同改进同一套共享技能与调度策略，而且全程不需要示范数据、也不更新模型权重。论文正文核对一致的数字：交错 3 个 benchmark、6 种机器人形态，每个 agent 模型采集 2,700 条学习 rollout，训练任务池合计 180 个任务（LIBERO-PRO / RoboTwin 2.0 / RoboCasa365），在未见场景与未见任务上的合并成功率从第 1 轮到第 3 轮提升 LIBERO-PRO 9–28 个百分点、RoboTwin 2.0 10.8–13.3、RoboCasa365 3.1–14.4；冻结已学技能后，零样本迁移到 4 种新机器人形态与 5 个额外 agent 模型（robosuite 与 RoboDojo）；另有 66 个未见场景用例与 36 个留出任务。对我们唯一可迁移的点是「把异构数据对齐到同一规范格式，比堆更多数据更有效」这一主张。

papers.title: BADAS-3.0: Real-Time Driving Perception and Planning from One Camera
papers.abstract: We ask how far a driving model can get with one camera and real-time latency. BADAS-3.0 is a 1B-parameter video encoder with four small heads. From two seconds of one forward camera, it predicts the current speed, the metric path just driven, a collision-risk score and six candidate futures over 6.4 seconds, in under 50 ms. Given the car's current speed, BADAS-3.0 has 44% lower minADE$_6$ over five trajectory benchmarks than the 34B Alpamayo 2 Super, which reads six cameras and runs over 100x slower. The gain comes from camera rigs that neither model was trained on. On the rig they share, the two are on par. Existing benchmarks are mostly nominal driving, so we add two open-loop safety benchmarks, one of real dashcam collisions and near-misses and one of Euro NCAP scenarios. On both, BADAS-3.0 has a higher pass rate than every published planner we tested.
papers.llm_reason: 自动驾驶方向，与主线距离最远，但它示范了一种「小模型 + 严格延迟预算 + 安全基准」的打法，且顺手补了主流 benchmark 缺的失败面。做法：BADAS-3.0 是一个 1B 参数视频 ViT（输入 2 秒单前视摄像头片段，256×256、8 fps，patch 16×16×2 → 2048 个 1408 维 token，40 层 transformer），配四个轻量读出头（轨迹头出 6 条候选未来轨迹加软选择分数、速度头回归当前车速、ego-pose 头预测刚驶过的米制路径、risk 头预测未来碰撞风险分），单次前向 43 ms。论文正文核对一致的数字与结论：给定当前车速时，minADE_6 比 34B 的 Alpamayo 2 Super 低 44%，而后者读六路摄像头且慢 100 倍以上；补齐其余 ego 历史带来的改进不足 1%；不给车速时用自己的速度估计，用 10 个样本标定可恢复大部分差距；NavSim 上 PDMS 89.0、微调后 91.1；另外新增两个开环安全基准（真实行车记录仪碰撞与险情的 DCA-Bench、Euro NCAP 协议场景仿真），在两者上通过率高于所测全部已发表 planner；backbone 从零用 V-JEPA 目标在约 110,000 小时专有行车记录视频上预训练。对我们的价值主要是「补充安全类基准」这个动作本身，以及「小模型也够用」的架构反例。

papers.title: Verifiable Logic in Medical LLMs: A Critical Review of Agentic Clinical Reasoning Optimization and Neuro-Symbolic Grounding
papers.abstract: Clinical large language models are usually judged by whether the final answer is right. Yet a model can reach a fluent, plausible output through invalid reasoning that static benchmarks do not detect, and confident hallucination, causally invalid inference, and spurious demographic shortcuts can pass conventional evaluation. This critical review covers four paradigms in turn: how clinical hallucination arises and why static metrics miss it; the agentic hallucination cascade, in which multi-agent and tool-augmented systems propagate and amplify early reasoning errors; process reward modeling as step-level supervision; and neuro-symbolic grounding, in which formal logic engines, ontology reasoners, and knowledge graphs place verifiable constraints on neural output. Within their encoded domains, systems with symbolic veto layers offer guarantees that hold relative to their encoded knowledge, and they report large gains on the safety measures they use. These results come from single studies, mostly in simulated or small-sample settings, and are not directly comparable with neural baselines. Process reward models remain bounded by the statistics of their training data. We propose a conceptual framework that maps each agentic failure mode to a symbolic intervention point, and we argue that clinical AI safety depends substantially on system architecture. Because current regulation emphasizes performance and does not require verification of reasoning steps, we argue that responsible certification should also audit reasoning trajectories alongside accuracy on static benchmarks.
papers.llm_reason: 它是一篇批判性综述，价值主要在它提出的框架而不是它的证据（作者自己就承认证据弱）。综述按四个范式展开：临床幻觉的成因与静态指标为何测不出；agentic hallucination cascade（多 agent 与工具增强系统会传播并放大早期推理错误，把早期错误当成已验证事实继承下去）；process reward modeling 作为步骤级监督；neuro-symbolic grounding（形式逻辑引擎、本体推理器、知识图谱给神经输出加可验证约束）。作者的结论有三层：符号否决层在其编码域内提供的保证是相对其编码知识成立的；这些结果来自单一研究、多为模拟或小样本设定，与纯神经基线不可直接比较；process reward model 受制于训练数据的统计特性。它的核心主张是最有价值的部分——临床 AI 安全实质上取决于系统架构，并据此主张监管认证除了静态基准的准确率之外还应审计推理轨迹。需要留意的是它的自我限定：采用 PRISMA-ScR 报告流程但明确声明未预注册方案，属叙述性综述而非形式化 scoping review。

papers.title: ALIoTh: Orchestrating Multi-Agent LLMs for Autonomous IoT Penetration Testing
papers.abstract: Penetration testing in Internet of Things (IoT) environments, especially those composed of various different devices, e.g., smart plugs, smart cameras, and smart doors, presents great challenges across the phases of information gathering, attack surface enumeration, privilege escalation, and lateral movement. This paper introduces ALIoTh, a multi-agent, workflow-driven penetration testing framework that integrates Large Language Models agents within a Self-Retrieval-Augmented Generation (Self-RAG) architecture to autonomously identify and exploit vulnerabilities in IoT and Industrial-IoT (IIoT) environments. By leveraging state-of-the-art language models and orchestrating specialized agents via the LangGraph framework, ALIoTh dynamically plans and executes a full-spectrum offensive pipeline. This includes network, devices, and service enumeration, vulnerability assessment, payload generation, reverse shell deployment, and privilege escalation on each device. The Self-RAG mechanism equips expert agents with contextual access to IoT security knowledge, e.g., related documentation, tool manuals, and known attack techniques, enhancing their reasoning capabilities in scenarios involving multiple device exploitation and group policy manipulation.
papers.llm_reason: 框架设计本身有可取之处（LangGraph 编排多个专职 agent、Self-RAG 给 Executor 注入 IoT 安全上下文、Shared Board 黑板在 Planner 与 Executor 之间传递已执行命令及其输出以减少重复探索、对高影响操作设 Human-in-the-Loop、对 DoS 类破坏性技术设确定性 kill-switch 并回传负奖励），但**本轮没有任何可核验的实测结果**：论文第 V 节原文自述「At the time of writing the experimental campaign is ongoing. The following section therefore describes the experimental design and performance indices.」，即只定义了 T_RCE / T_Shell / T_Root / Tok_total / SR 五个指标与一个三设备实验室靶场（IP Camera 的 RTSP 劫持与默认凭据、Smart Plug 的 HTTP 头命令注入、MQTT Gateway 的匿名订阅），实验结果尚未产出。GitHub 仓库检索未找到 ALIoTh 实现，anonymous 入口也未在文中给出。因此本轮按「证据不足」处理：保留最小索引（标题、来源、框架结构），但不投入深读与工程搜索，等它补上实测数字再重新评估。
